title: Turkey Officially Accuses Netanyahu of Genocide; Netanyahu Calls Erdoğan Antisemitic Dictator
detail: Turkey officially accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of genocide over the ongoing war in Gaza on August 22, 2026. Netanyahu retaliated by calling President Erdoğan an antisemitic dictator, marking a sharp escalation in Turkey-Israel diplomatic rhetoric. The exchange underscores the deep rupture in once-close bilateral relations since the Gaza conflict began.
